description: NFC under Unicode 16.0.0: 'a' U+1ACF U+0323 stays unchanged (U+1ACF is unassigned in 16.0, ccc 0, so it blocks; Unicode 17.0 gives it ccc 230, reorders and composes to U+1EA1 U+1ACF)
notes: Version guard in the other direction (spec §3.4.1.1): the encoding must not move to Unicode 17.0 (unicode-normalization 0.1.25) silently. Under 16.0.0 the label is already NFC: bytes 61 E1 AB 8F CC A3 (len prefix 6). Expected bytes written by hand from the spec layout, hash by the xxhash package.
